    50	 * as a working one does.

   241	/* RGB565 byte order on the wire.  Shared: both panels are the same part.
   242	 *
   243	 * The panel takes the high byte of each 16-bit pixel first.  The vendor's
   244	 * own fill helper (lcd_spi_display_fill_pure_color() in
   245	 * bk_avdk_smp/projects/spi_lcd_example/ap/ap_main.c) stores
   246	 * `data[0] = color >> 8; data[1] = color;` into the frame buffer and then
   247	 * DMAs it verbatim into the data window, which establishes that wire order
   248	 * == memory byte order for this window.
   249	 *
   250	 * NuttX's FB_FMT_RGB16_565 is host-endian, so a little-endian uint16 store
   251	 * puts the low byte first and the driver has to swap each halfword on its
   252	 * way out.  Doing it here rather than asking applications to store
   253	 * big-endian keeps /dev/fbN conformant.
   254	 *

   256	 * (0x06E0) shows as green; had the swap been wrong it would have appeared
   257	 * as 0xE006, a dark red.

   270	static inline uint32_t gc9_swap16x2(uint32_t w)
   271	{

   286	{

   324	 ****************************************************************************/
   325	
   326	static bool lcd_xfer_short(FAR struct lcd_bus_s *b, const uint8_t *data,
   327	                           uint32_t len)
   328	{

   333	  putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_H);
   334	  putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG1);
   335	  putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2);

   350	       * opcode -- not a QSPI header -- is going out.

   359	             (unsigned int)getreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2),

   368	/****************************************************************************
   369	 * Name: lcd_xfer_fifo
   370	 *
   371	 * Description:
   372	 *   Shifts out the first 4 bytes through cmd_c_h and the next 'fifo_len'
   373	 *   bytes through the TX FIFO, as
   374	 *   lcd_spi_send_data_with_qspi_indirect_mode()'s long branch does.  Bytes
   375	 *   are assembled one at a time so an unaligned source pointer is safe (a
   376	 *   command table entry's payload generally is not word aligned).
   377	 *
   378	 ****************************************************************************/
   379	
   380	static bool lcd_xfer_fifo(FAR struct lcd_bus_s *b, const uint8_t *data,
   381	                          uint32_t fifo_len)
   382	{
   383	  uint32_t words = (fifo_len + 3u) / 4u;
   384	  uint32_t value;
   385	  uint32_t i;
   386	
   387	  value = ((uint32_t)data[0]) |
   388	          ((uint32_t)data[1] << 8) |
   389	          ((uint32_t)data[2] << 16) |
   390	          ((uint32_t)data[3] << 24);
   391	
   392	  putreg32(value, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_H);
   393	  putreg32(QSPI_CFG1_FIFO_PAYLOAD, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG1);
   394	  putreg32(fifo_len << QSPI_CFG2_DATA_LEN_SHIFT,
   395	           b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2);
   396	
   397	  for (i = 0; i < words; i++)
   398	    {
   399	      uint32_t word = 0;
   400	      uint32_t k;
   401	
   402	      for (k = 0; k < 4u; k++)
   403	        {
   404	          uint32_t idx = i * 4u + k;
   405	
   406	          if (idx < fifo_len)
   407	            {
   408	              word |= ((uint32_t)data[4u + idx]) << (k * 8);
   409	            }
   410	        }
   411	
   412	      putreg32(word, b->base + QSPI_OFF_FIFO_DATA + i * 4u);
   413	    }
   414	
   415	  modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2, 0, QSPI_CMD_START_BIT);
   416	
   417	  return lcd_wait_done(b);
   418	}

   420	static bool lcd_xfer(FAR struct lcd_bus_s *b, const uint8_t *data,
   421	                     uint32_t len)
   422	{
   423	  uint32_t remain = len;
   424	  const uint8_t *p = data;
   425	
   426	  while (remain > 0)
   427	    {
   428	      uint32_t fifo_len;
   429	
   430	      if (remain <= 4u)
   431	        {
   432	          return lcd_xfer_short(b, p, remain);
   433	        }
   434	
   435	      fifo_len = remain - 4u;
   436	      if (fifo_len > QSPI_FIFO_MAX_BYTES)
   437	        {
   438	          fifo_len = QSPI_FIFO_MAX_BYTES;
   439	        }
   440	
   441	      if (!lcd_xfer_fifo(b, p, fifo_len))
   442	        {
   443	          return false;
   444	        }
   445	
   446	      p += 4u + fifo_len;
   447	      remain -= 4u + fifo_len;
   448	    }
   449	
   450	  return true;
   451	}

   456	
   457	void bk7258_lcd_spi_init(int bus, unsigned int dc_pin)
   458	{
   459	  FAR struct lcd_bus_s *b = lcd_bus(bus);
   460	
   461	  if (b == NULL)
   462	    {
   463	      return;
   464	    }
   465	
   466	  b->dc_pin = dc_pin;

   468	  /* 1. Module clock gate.  Without this the controller's command state
   469	   * machine has no clock and cmd_start_done never asserts.
   470	   */

   473	
   474	  /* 2. Source clock: 480MHz / 8 = 60MHz, the divider path bk_qspi_init()
   475	   * uses.  config.clk_rate stays 0 (cleared in step 4).  Note the two
   476	   * controllers use different sysctrl registers.
   477	   */

   479	  modifyreg32(b->clkdiv_reg, b->ckdiv_mask,
   480	              (QSPI_SRC_CLK_DIV_60M << b->ckdiv_shift) | b->cksel_480m);

   490	  bk7258_gpio_set_function(b->io0_pin, b->pinmux);
   491	  bk7258_gpio_output(b->dc_pin, true);

   493	  /* 4. Controller enable, qspi_ll_init_common(): qspi_en + io2_io3_mode.
   494	   * io2_io3_mode makes IO2/IO3 driven from config.io2/io3 instead of by
   495	   * the shifter, which is correct when only one data line is wired.
   496	   */

   498	  modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, QSPI_CONFIG_CLK_RATE_MASK,
   499	              QSPI_CONFIG_QSPI_EN | QSPI_CONFIG_IO2_IO3_MODE);

   578	bool bk7258_lcd_spi_write_frame(int bus, const void *frame, size_t len)

   608	  putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_H);
   609	  putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG1);
   610	  putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2);
   611	
   612	  modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, 0, QSPI_CONFIG_FORCE_SPI_CS_LOW);
   613	  modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, 0, QSPI_CONFIG_IO_CPU_MEM_SEL);
   614	  modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, 0, QSPI_CONFIG_DISABLE_CMD_SCK);

   619	             "src=%p first_px=0x%04x swap=%u\n", b->name,
   620	             (unsigned int)b->frames,

   622	             (unsigned int)words, frame,
   623	              (unsigned int)(src[0] & 0xffff),
   624	             (unsigned int)g_swap_bytes);
   625	    }

   627	  /* CPU-driven copy.  The controller back-pressures the AHB write when its
   628	   * FIFO is full, so this self-throttles to the wire rate; 160x160 RGB565

   660	  b->frames++;

   662	}
